rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Dredd performs pre-flight security checks before MCP agent tool calls, detecting compromised dependencies, unauthorized tool drift, and configuration tampering. It uses HMAC signatures to verify tool integrity and exposes both a hosted remote endpoint and a local package for embedded use in agent pipelines.
